messages:
incident-bot: [PAGE] prefill-oom spike detected in us-west-1 (severity=2). Auto-create incident channel: #incident-prefill-1712456789
alice: seeing ~30 container restarts on gpu-pool-3 over last 5m, likely prefill OOM: long prompts + kv cache growth
bob_oncall: on it, attaching tail of pod logs from runtime-abc-123
bob_oncall: ```
2024-05-11T15:12:34Z ERROR runtime: cuda runtime error (2): out of memory
stacktrace: ...
alloc_kv_cache: requested 24GiB, available 8GiB
container restart reason: OOMKilled
```
charlie_ops: noted, isolating noisy tenant traffic -> applying authz rule to throttle heavy request size
alice: can we drain node gpu-node-7? it's flapping
sre-oncall: let's cordon and drain gracefully, command in k8s:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7 && kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
bob_oncall: starting drain, also pinning model to smaller-variant (quantized) for affected group
ml-runtime: rolling config patch to reduce PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS for public routes to 8192, applying now
ml-runtime: ```yaml
- op: replace
  path: /services/runtime/prefill_max_tokens
  value: 8192
```
support-lead: flagging customers with long-context usage, drafting quick note: "We're mitigating elevated error rates; if you're seeing failures, try reducing prompt length or switch to smaller model" :speech_balloon:
alice: mitigation action list:
- throttle large payloads at gateway
- route heavy requests to quantized fallback
- drain noisy node
- restart affected pool
bob_oncall: restarted runtime pods on gpu-pool-3; error rate dropping
bob_oncall: post-restart check: memory pressure gone, no further OOM kills in last 90s
sre-oncall: monitoring graphs -> GPU mem utilization back to baseline, creating alert suppression for 10m
charlie_ops: customer comms posted to #customer-updates, linking incident page
incident-bot: incident channel created: #incident-prefill-1712456789, status: mitigated -> monitoring
alice: will follow-up with postmortem, likely causes: long-window prefill + kv-cache eviction insufficiency + one noisy tenant
ml-runtime: creating a hotpatch to add defensive KV allocation cap and better fallback on prefill failure
support-lead: collecting impacted customer list for outreach
bob_oncall: handing to day oncall for post-incident scrub, @sre-oncall please own postmortem
sre-oncall: acked, will schedule scrub and RCA
alice: thanks all, marking this thread closed unless new regressions appear :white_check_mark:
